thread:
maria: Observability alert — queue spike in us-west-2 at 10:12am. queued=220 p95_queue_ms=1600
john: Any sign of node failures or network flaps? Was there autoscaler churn?
maria: No node OOMs. Warm pool was almost depleted; we had 24 pending launches. admission kept allowing requests which clogged KV caches and slowed everything.
kai: Classic admission vs warm inventory mismatch. If warm_pool_util>90% we should throttle new admission and force queueing/backoff.
andre: Launch latency in that AZ hit 30s because of batch image pulls + preemption churn. That kills the warm strategy unless we factor launch_wait into admission.
lena: I prototyped a token-bucket admission limiter that references prewarmed_count and p95_launch_ms. Config snippet:
```
prewarm_target: 200
headroom_pct: 0.2
admission_policy: token_bucket
tokens_per_gpu: 10
burst_scale: 0.5
launch_latency_source: p95_launch_ms
max_backpressure_ms: 2000
```
maria: Proposed runtime behavior: when headroom < headroom_pct -> switch to conservative token refill (lower rate) and tag requests with admit_reason. If cold starts spike, raise cold_start_backoff timer to reduce thrash.
john: Can we make token refill = f(1 / p95_launch_ms) so longer launches reduce token rate? Also prefer routing to other regions if they have spare headroom.
kai: Yes, plus tie burst budget to active_launches so we don't hand out bursts that immediately trigger new launches.
andre: Region nuance: staging eu-west3 has 3x launch latency vs us-west so use per-region headroom and per-region admission overrides. Also prefer warm replica pools in healthier regions.
autoscaler-bot: [alert] warm_pool_utilization=96% us-west-2 g5x-pool | pending_launches=24 | avg_launch_sec=32
maria: Rollout plan: alpha test in staging, then 5% traffic canary with metric gates: p95_queue_ms < 500ms, 429_rate < 0.2%, warm_pool_utilization < 90%.
lena: Telemetry reqs: emit admit_reason (steady|burst|conservative), tokens_used, per-request launch_wait_ms, warm_pool_headroom gauge.
john: Also add a dashboard panel for spillover: routes redirected to other regions + cross-region latency.
andre: Cost vs latency tradeoff in sim: +25% prewarmed GPUs -> p95_queue down 65% but idle GPU-hours +19%. I'll draft a slide for finance.
kai: For canary: autoscaler-bot should aggregate alerts and mute noisy alarms during the experiment window.
autoscaler-bot: [note] canary adm-policy/tokenbucket-v1 deployed to 5% -> monitoring for 30m
maria: Next actions: PR with policy + sim results + dashboards. I'll include gating thresholds and a rollback plan. Owners: @lena for policy, @john for dashboards, @andre for cost slides.
john: I'll review the PR and run staging sim.
maria: Thanks team. Short-term: implement conservative admission when warm_pool_headroom < 15% and emit telemetry. Long-term: explore predictive prewarm based on incoming request rate models. :thumbsup:
